questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: Traditional articles in MCQ01; BVI BC distribution regime in MCQ02.
questions.stem: AB Ltd has traditional articles reproducing Appendix 1B article 23.1. It has distributable profits and proposes a final cash dividend. Which document route must be used?

options.A: Appendix 19A board recommendation followed by Appendix 19B members' declaration.
options.B: Appendix 19C board-only declaration.
options.C: Appendix 20E director-authorised solvency distribution.
options.D: Appendices 20B and 20D shareholder-loan repayment.

questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: BVI BC distribution regime in MCQ02; traditional articles in MCQ01.
questions.stem: AB Ltd is a BVI BC governed by the BVI Business Companies Act 2004. It has distributable funds and proposes the same final cash payment to its member. Which document route must be used?

options.A: Appendix 19A board recommendation followed by Appendix 19B members' declaration.
options.B: Appendix 19C board-only declaration.

options.D: Appendices 20B and 20D shareholder-loan repayment.

questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: Voluntary sale by living holder in MCQ03; death and personal-representative election in MCQ04.
questions.stem: A living registered shareholder voluntarily sells issued shares to a buyer, and the articles require board approval. Which route is correct?

options.A: Appendix 26 plus a new Appendix 27A or 27B nominee instrument.
options.B: Appendix 18E with probate evidence.
options.C: Appendix 16C allotment and issue resolution.
options.D: Appendix 18A transfer form followed by Appendix 18B board approval and register/certificate updates.

questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: Death and personal-representative election in MCQ04; voluntary sale in MCQ03.
questions.stem: The registered shareholder has died, and the personal representative elects to be registered in the deceased's place. Which route is correct?

options.A: Appendix 26 plus a new Appendix 27A or 27B nominee instrument.
options.B: Appendix 18E with death and probate evidence.
options.C: Appendix 16C allotment and issue resolution.
options.D: Appendix 18A transfer form followed by Appendix 18B board approval and register/certificate updates.

questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: Registered nominee stays in MCQ05; registered nominee is replaced in MCQ06.
questions.stem: The beneficial owner transfers only the beneficial interest to a new client; the same nominee remains the registered shareholder. Which statement is incorrect?

options.A: The Appendix 26 and new Appendix 27A or 27B route is sufficient for the title change described.
options.B: The beneficial-owner register and FATCA/CRS records may require updating.
options.C: The register of members must be changed to replace the nominee.
options.D: A share transfer form is needed only if legal title also moves.

questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: Registered nominee is replaced in MCQ06; nominee stays in MCQ05.

options.A: The Appendix 26 and new Appendix 27A or 27B route is sufficient for the title change described.
options.B: The beneficial-owner register and FATCA/CRS records may require updating.
options.C: The register of members must be changed to replace the nominee.
options.D: A share transfer form is needed only if legal title also moves.

questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: Restrictive company objects are defective in MCQ07; director authority is defective in MCQ08.
questions.stem: The directors were otherwise properly authorised, but the proposed transaction falls outside the company's restrictive objects. Which source route is not contradicted by the course materials?

options.A: Corporate capacity under Module 5 section 2.4 is primary; director authority under Module 8 is conditional.
options.B: Shareholder reserve power under Module 7 section 2 is primary.
options.C: Meeting procedure under Module 10 alone governs.
options.D: Director authority under Module 8 section 1.3 is primary; capacity is merely conditional.

questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: Traditional article 80 management power in MCQ09; express shareholder reserve power in MCQ10.
questions.stem: The board refuses a proposed acquisition. The company's management article is the unmodified 1948/Table A article 80 form reproduced in Appendix 1B article 19.1. All propositions are incorrect EXCEPT:

options.A: Shareholders may always bind the board by ordinary resolution.
options.B: Shareholders cannot presently bind the board; they must first alter the articles if they wish to control this director power.
options.C: Shareholders may direct the board by special resolution under an existing reserve power and use Appendix 21G.
options.D: Share ownership alone displaces the board's management power.

options.C: Shareholders may direct the board by special resolution under an existing reserve power and use Appendix 21G.
options.D: Share ownership alone displaces the board's management power.

questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: Assets/liabilities remain in MCQ17; zero-state eligibility in MCQ18.
questions.stem: A solvent company has assets to realise and liabilities to pay before surplus can be returned to members. Which route may properly be initiated to terminate it?

options.A: Voluntary striking off under Appendix 31A plus the jurisdictionally applicable Appendix 31B or 31C.
options.B: Administrative reinstatement under Appendix 31D.
options.C: Members' voluntary winding-up beginning with Appendices 30A and 30B and continuing through the applicable notices/final-account chain.
options.D: Compulsory winding-up solely because the members no longer want the company.

questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: Zero-state eligibility in MCQ18; assets/liabilities remain in MCQ17.
questions.stem: The same jurisdiction permits voluntary striking off, and the company now has no assets, liabilities, claims, proceedings, or business. Which route may properly be initiated to terminate it?

options.A: Voluntary striking off under Appendix 31A plus the jurisdictionally applicable Appendix 31B or 31C.
options.B: Administrative reinstatement under Appendix 31D.
options.C: Members' voluntary winding-up beginning with Appendices 30A and 30B and continuing through the applicable notices/final-account chain.
options.D: Compulsory winding-up solely because the members no longer want the company.

questions.single_fact_change_from_pair: Bilateral agreement requested in MCQ19; unilateral declaration requested in MCQ20.
questions.stem: The parties want a bilateral nominee shareholder agreement between the registered nominee and beneficial owner. Which is the best-supported course-material route?

options.A: Appendix 26 alone is a complete nominee agreement.
options.B: Open Appendix 27B, report that 'etc., as above' leaves operative provisions missing, and do not invent them.
options.C: Appendix 18A is the nominee agreement because shares are involved.
options.D: Appendix 27A is the bilateral source, but its terms must be adapted and must not be represented as universally complete.
